items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: Mr. Blakeney recorded with the C.L. Burk Orchestra in Los Angeles. ... guitar and leader, also vocalist, C.L. Burk.

ctx.x: I stayed with C.L. Burk three and a half years, ending at the Club Alabam on Central Avenue, L.A. The stay at the Alabam was very short due to the fact we were working for Curtis Mosby who was trying to stage a comeback in the nightclub form.
Mr. Curtis Mosby was very well known for his wheeling dealings in the area. I think he was the brother of Red Mack, who was--Mrs. Hightower taught Red Mack and Curtis Mosby was his brother.
